abandonment_reason.decision: Do not continue brute-force whole-sector scheduling as the primary strategy.
reasons: The computation is incomplete: 1352 of 2744 canonical sectors completed, 1392 missing.
The long tail already contains multi-hour sectors, including observed sectors around 7.7 hours.
The handoff identifies fusion-path sparse state blow-up during braid quantum trace evaluation as the dominant bottleneck.
Whole-sector parallelism increases throughput on easy sectors but does not reduce total work for the hard tail.
The handoff does not preserve enough provenance or evaluator-code identity to justify more large brute-force runs without first repairing reproducibility.
